Permanent A/V

State of the Art A/V Installations Built to Last.

Permanent and semi-permanent audio, video, and lighting systems — designed, installed, and supported by the same team that runs your live events.

Spaces We Outfit

The Right System for Every Space

Conference Rooms

Ceiling microphone arrays, display systems, video conferencing integration, and room control — all permanently installed and ready every time.

Auditoriums & Lecture Halls

Professional speaker systems, projection and LED displays, lighting control, and ADA Compliance built into every design for permanent classroom and performance venues.

Houses of Worship

Full-range PA systems, broadcast cameras, streaming infrastructure, and hearing assistance systems tailored to the unique acoustic and community needs of worship spaces.

Corporate Campuses

Multi-room audio and video distribution, lobby displays, all-hands auditoriums, and centralized control systems that keep your campus connected.

Hotel & Event Venues

State of the art in-house A/V infrastructure — ballrooms, breakout rooms, pre-function spaces — giving venues the capability to host events at any scale without outside rentals.

Performing Arts Spaces

Professional-grade audio, lighting, and video systems designed for live performance — from black box theaters to full proscenium stages.

Our Standards

Quality and Compliance You Can Count On.

Every installation we deliver is built to the highest quality standards — state of the art equipment chosen for longevity and performance, not just price. We design all systems with ADA Compliance as a core requirement, not an afterthought, ensuring your space is accessible and inclusive for everyone who uses it.

ADA Compliance

Accessible control panels and assistive listening systems are engineered into every installation from the start.

State of the Art Equipment

We specify equipment that performs reliably for years — trusted brands used at professional venues and broadcast facilities worldwide.

Groups of 20 or 2000

Our installations scale to fit the space. From a small conference room to a full auditorium, the system is sized and tuned for your actual usage.

How It Works

Our Installation Process

01

Site Assessment

We visit your space, evaluate acoustics, existing infrastructure, and usage requirements before recommending any equipment.

02

System Design

Our team designs a system tailored to your space — documented with diagrams, equipment lists, and a full project scope before any work begins.

03

Installation

Clean, professional installation with fully concealed cabling, proper mounting, and zero shortcuts. We treat your space like our own.

04

Testing & Tuning

Every system is tuned and tested to perform at its best in your specific room — including acoustic measurement and signal path verification.

05

Training

We train your staff to operate the system confidently. No black boxes, no mystery — your team should own the technology.

06

Ongoing Support

We remain available for service, upgrades, and support. A permanent installation is a long-term relationship.
